records.jp: あれ？　みんなで何してんの？
records.en_original: Oh, hey. What are you all up to?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hey. What are you all up to?
records.en: Huh? What are you all doing?

records.jp: 聞いてよ、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Ao! Did you know?!
records.en_auxiliary: Ao! Did you know?!
records.en: Listen, Ao-chan!

records.jp: お姉ちゃんも詩ちゃんも、自撮りしたこと<CR>ないんだって！
records.en_original: Mio and Uta said they've never taken a selfie before!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio and Uta said they've never taken a selfie before!
records.en: Onee-chan and Uta-chan say they have never<CR>taken a selfie before!

records.jp: （たしかに、したことなさそう……<CR>ていうか、想像できない）
records.en_original: (I can see that. I can't even imagine them trying to take one.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I can see that. I can't even imagine them trying to take one.)
records.en: (That does seem believable...<CR>Rather, I can't picture it.)

records.jp: もー！　信じられないよー！
records.en_original: My gosh! I can't believe it!
records.en_auxiliary: My gosh! I can't believe it!
records.en: Geez! I can't believe it~!

records.jp: でも……自分の撮影をすることが、<CR>なぜ楽しいのかが分かりません……
records.en_original: I simply don't understand what could be so entertaining about taking a picture of yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: I simply don't understand what could be so entertaining about taking a picture of yourself.
records.en: But... I don't understand why photographing yourself<CR>would be fun...

records.jp: 私も同感ね。<CR>自分の顔なんて、鏡を見れば十分だし
records.en_original: I don't either. If you need to see you face, why not just look in a mirror?
records.en_auxiliary: I don't either. If you need to see you face, why not just look in a mirror?
records.en: Same here.<CR>If I want to see my own face, a mirror is enough.

records.jp: あーもー！　ふたりともこれだよ～！<CR>愛央ちゃん、自撮りって楽しいよね！？
records.en_original: Ugh! You two just don't get it! Ao, you agree that taking a selfie is fun, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh! You two just don't get it! Ao, you agree that taking a selfie is fun, right?
records.en: Aah, come on! You two are like this again~!<CR>Ao-chan, selfies are fun, right!?

records.jp: うん。鏡で見るのと全然違うし
records.en_original: Yeah. It's totally different from just looking at yourself in the mirror.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. It's totally different from just looking at yourself in the mirror.
records.en: Yeah. It's totally different from seeing yourself in a mirror.

records.jp: ……そういうもの、なんですか？
records.en_original: ...Is it?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Is it?
records.en: ...Is that really how it works?

records.jp: そういうものなんだよ～！<CR>てことで、みんなで自撮り大会しようよ！
records.en_original: It is! So I say we see who can take the best selfie!
records.en_auxiliary: It is! So I say we see who can take the best selfie!
records.en: That's just how it is~!<CR>So let's all have a selfie contest!

records.jp: いいねいいね！　やろうよ！
records.en_original: Ooh, I like that! Let's do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, I like that! Let's do it!
records.en: Sounds good, sounds good! Let's do it!

records.jp: ね！　お姉ちゃんもやるよね？
records.en_original: Mio? You're in, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Mio? You're in, right?
records.en: Right!? You'll do it too, Onee-chan, right?

records.jp: ……陽桜莉がそんなに言うなら
records.en_original: ...If you say so, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: ...If you say so, Hiori.
records.en: ...If Hiori insists.

records.jp: 私が自分の顔を撮っても、面白いものが<CR>撮れるとは思いませんが……
records.en_original: I still doubt there will be anything interesting about taking a picture of myself.
records.en_auxiliary: I still doubt there will be anything interesting about taking a picture of myself.
records.en: Even if I were to photograph my own face,<CR>I don't think it would produce anything interesting...

records.jp: 面白いかどうかは、撮ってから！<CR>じゃあ、始めるよ！
records.en_original: We'll just have to take them and see! All right, here we go!
records.en_auxiliary: We'll just have to take them and see! All right, here we go!
records.en: Whether it's interesting or not comes after you take it!<CR>All right, let's begin!

records.jp: みんな撮れたみたいだね。<CR>美弦さん、だいぶ苦戦してたみたいだけど
records.en_original: Looks like everybody was able to take one. Though Mio looked like she was having trouble with it.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like everybody was able to take one. Though Mio looked like she was having trouble with it.
records.en: Looks like everybody got one.<CR>Mio-san, though, it seemed like you were having quite a hard time.

records.jp: ね、愛央ちゃん。<CR>誰のが一番よく撮れてると思う？
records.en_original: So, Ao. Who do you think took the best selfie?
records.en_auxiliary: So, Ao. Who do you think took the best selfie?
records.en: Hey, Ao-chan.<CR>Whose do you think turned out the best?

records.jp: そうだなぁ……自分のは置いといて……
records.en_original: Hmm... Well, other than myself...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Well, other than myself...
records.en: Let me see... putting my own aside...

records.jp: やっぱ陽桜莉さんかな！<CR>さっすが撮り慣れてるよねー
records.en_original: I think you did, Hiori! You're so good at this!
records.en_auxiliary: I think you did, Hiori! You're so good at this!
records.en: I guess Hiori-san's!<CR>As expected, you're used to taking them.

records.jp: えへ。そうかな？
records.en_original: Hehe. You think so?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. You think so?
records.en: Ehehe. You think so?

records.jp: 私もそこそこ自撮りしてるけど、ほらー。<CR>陽桜莉さんと比べるとダンチだし
records.en_original: I mean, I've taken my fair share of selfies, but you're way more experienced with it.
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, I've taken my fair share of selfies, but you're way more experienced with it.
records.en: I take a fair number of selfies too, but look.<CR>Compared to Hiori-san's, it's a whole different league.

records.jp: え？　愛央ちゃんのもよく撮れてるよ？
records.en_original: Yours aren't bad either, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Yours aren't bad either, Ao.
records.en: Huh? Yours turned out well too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: でも、陽桜莉さんのは自然体ーって感じなのに、<CR>すっごく陽桜莉さんの良さが出てるよねー
records.en_original: But yours look so natural, while still emphasizing all your good features.
records.en_auxiliary: But yours look so natural, while still emphasizing all your good features.
records.en: But Hiori-san's feels so natural,<CR>and it really brings out what's great about Hiori-san.

records.jp: えへへっ。<CR>こういうのはテクがあるんだよ、テクが
records.en_original: Heheh. I guess there is a bit of skill involved.
records.en_auxiliary: Heheh. I guess there is a bit of skill involved.
records.en: Eheheh.<CR>There's a trick to this, you know. A trick.

records.jp: えー。今度教えてー！
records.en_original: Ooh, teach me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, teach me!
records.en: Ooh. Teach me next time!

records.jp: 美弦さん……かな。<CR>
records.en_original: Probably Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: Probably Mio.
records.en: Mio-san... maybe.<CR>

records.jp: え、私？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?
records.en: Huh, me?

records.jp: すごい決まってるし……かっこいい……！<CR>なんか、意外な一面を見た感じ！
records.en_original: You look so sharp and cool! It almost feels like we got to see another side of you!
records.en_auxiliary: You look so sharp and cool! It almost feels like we got to see another side of you!
records.en: It looks so perfectly put together... so cool...!<CR>It feels like we got to see an unexpected side of you!

records.jp: 悔しいけど、確かに……<CR>お姉ちゃん、自撮りしたことないって嘘でしょ！？
records.en_original: You're so right. Mio, you lied about never having taken a selfie, didn't you?!
records.en_auxiliary: You're so right. Mio, you lied about never having taken a selfie, didn't you?!
records.en: It annoys me, but it's true...<CR>Onee-chan, you were lying when you said you'd never taken a selfie before, right!?

records.jp: 本当に初めてなのだけど……<CR>こう言ってはなんだけど、私、本番に強いのよ
records.en_original: This really is my first time, but...I do excel in competitions.
records.en_auxiliary: This really is my first time, but...I do excel in competitions.
records.en: It really is my first time...<CR>But if I do say so myself, I perform well under pressure.

records.jp: うー。なんか悔しい～！
records.en_original: Uggggh. This is so not fair!
records.en_auxiliary: Uggggh. This is so not fair!
records.en: Ugh, this is so frustrating~!

records.jp: ふふ。まだまだね、陽桜莉
records.en_original: Hehe. Maybe next time, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. Maybe next time, Hiori.
records.en: Hehe. You still have a long way to go, Hiori.

records.jp: ……詩さん、かな
records.en_original: I'd have to say Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd have to say Uta.
records.en: ...Uta-san, I think.

records.jp: 私……ですか？
ほんとだ！<CR>詩ちゃん、よく撮れてる！
records.en_original: Wow! That's such a good selfie, Uta!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! That's such a good selfie, Uta!
records.en: You're right!<CR>That came out really well, Uta-chan!

records.jp: でも、ただ普段の顔を写しただけですよ？<CR>笑ってもいませんし……
records.en_original: But I just took a picture of myself. I'm not even smiling.
records.en_auxiliary: But I just took a picture of myself. I'm not even smiling.
records.en: But I just took a picture of my usual face.<CR>I'm not even smiling...

records.jp: むしろそこがいい！<CR>なんていうか、詩さんの雰囲気がよく写ってる！
records.en_original: That's what makes it so good! It really captures your personality!
records.en_auxiliary: That's what makes it so good! It really captures your personality!
records.en: That's exactly why it's good!<CR>How do I put it? It really captured Uta-san's atmosphere!

records.jp: 雰囲気が……写る、ですか？
records.en_original: My...personality?
records.en_auxiliary: My...personality?
records.en: My atmosphere... got captured?

records.jp: 私には、私の姿が映っているだけに見えます。<CR>……ますますよく分かりません
records.en_original: I really just see a picture with me in it. I don't understand.
records.en_auxiliary: I really just see a picture with me in it. I don't understand.
records.en: To me, it just looks like my appearance was reflected in it.<CR>...I understand even less now.

records.jp: なんか、写真って面白いよね。<CR>撮る人によって、全然違うんだもん
records.en_original: Pictures are really interesting. They come out so different depending on who takes them.
records.en_auxiliary: Pictures are really interesting. They come out so different depending on who takes them.
records.en: Photos are kind of interesting, huh.<CR>They come out completely differently depending on who takes them.

records.jp: ……そうですね。興味深かったです。<CR>自分の顔も、証明写真とはどこか違って見えます
records.en_original: That is true. It was a fascinating experience. My picture looks different from other pictures of me.
records.en_auxiliary: That is true. It was a fascinating experience. My picture looks different from other pictures of me.
records.en: ...Yes. It was interesting.<CR>Even my own face somehow looks different from it does in an ID photo.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんも楽しかった？　ならよかった～！<CR>ね、今度は一緒に撮ろうよ！
records.en_original: So you had fun too, Uta? That's great! Let's take some together next!
records.en_auxiliary: So you had fun too, Uta? That's great! Let's take some together next!
records.en: Did you have fun too, Uta-chan? I'm glad~!<CR>Let's take one together next time!

records.jp: え……一緒に、ですか？
records.en_original: Wha... Together?
records.en_auxiliary: Wha... Together?
records.en: Huh... Together?

records.jp: それにしても、いきなりこのメンツで<CR>自撮り大会なんて、びっくりしちゃったよ～
records.en_original: You know, I never expected this group of us would have a selfie competition.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, I never expected this group of us would have a selfie competition.
records.en: Even so, a selfie contest with this lineup all of a sudden<CR>really surprised me~

records.jp: 陽桜莉がね。詩がいつもひとりでいるから、<CR>もっとたくさん話したいって
records.en_original: Well, Hiori wanted to get to know Uta better because she's always alone.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, Hiori wanted to get to know Uta better because she's always alone.
records.en: It was Hiori. Because Uta is always by herself,<CR>she said she wanted to talk with her more.

records.jp: そっか。陽桜莉さんらしいなぁ
records.en_original: I see. That sounds like something Hiori would say.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. That sounds like something Hiori would say.
records.en: I see. That really is like Hiori-san.

records.jp: うわ～！　も～、お姉ちゃん！<CR>恥ずかしいから言わないでよぉ～！
records.en_original: Ugh, Mio! You're embarrassing me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, Mio! You're embarrassing me!
records.en: Waaah! Geez, Onee-chan!<CR>Don't say that, it's embarrassing~!

records.jp: 私なんかと……。<CR>陽桜莉さん、ありがとうございます
records.en_original: You wanted to get to know me? Thank you, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: You wanted to get to know me? Thank you, Hiori.
records.en: With someone like me...<CR>Hiori-san, thank you very much.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん。星崎さんと美弦さんも……<CR>私と一緒に、写真を撮ってもらえますか？
records.en_original: Hiori. Would you, Mio, and Ao take a selfie with me?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori. Would you, Mio, and Ao take a selfie with me?
records.en: Hiori-san. Hoshizaki-san and Mio-san as well...<CR>would you take a picture together with me?
